excerpt: Honen, from the StudyFetch team, turns a company's docs, recordings and knowledge base into AI-led training courses with simulations, quizzes and a voice tutor, and updates them when the source material changes. Team plan $20/seat/month (10-seat minimum). Features and alternatives.
content:
Honen is an AI platform for employee training. You drag in training documents, call recordings or videos, connect a knowledge source such as Google Drive, or just type a topic, and it builds a full course: lessons in nine formats including reading, flashcards, quizzes, lectures, podcasts, comics and games, AI-generated video lessons and a voice tutor. Practice comes as projects, such as a mock client call graded against a rubric or a screen-share walkthrough of a software tool. Admins assign courses, track progress and can ask a course agent why learners are struggling with a topic.

Its main pitch is that courses keep up with the company. Courses are tied to a team knowledge base, so when docs or processes change the course can be updated, with full version history and rollback; the team said a person always approves what reaches learners. Courses can be shared as a link or a branded site, exported as SCORM to an existing LMS, and the same knowledge base can be served to AI agents over MCP. Honen's pricing page says it is SOC 2 Type II certified and that it does not train AI on customer content.

Honen is built by StudyFetch, which says it has taught more than 8 million students. It launched on Product Hunt on 8 June 2026, its first launch there, and finished #1 for the day with 505 upvotes and 112 comments.

We have not tested Honen ourselves. This page brings together Honen's official site, pricing and about pages, its Product Hunt page, reviews and launch discussion, and the official pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web, with SCORM and LMS delivery
profile.summary_short: AI-built employee training courses that stay in sync with your company's docs
use_cases: Turning messy onboarding docs into a structured course
Building a sales ramp with graded mock client calls
Keeping compliance or SOP training current as documents change
Exporting courses to an existing LMS through SCORM
Giving staff and AI agents the same knowledge base

paragraphs: Ryan Trattner says StudyFetch had helped 8 million students learn, and Honen brings what the team learned to businesses. The problem he describes is companies spending heavily on generic training that is half-stale by the time a course is finished.

He presented Honen as automated learning infrastructure: build a course in seconds from your docs or a topic, send it by link or into your LMS, keep learners engaged with personalised formats and hands-on projects, and let admins ask the course agent what is going wrong. He also announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to bring AI training to students and professionals.
launch_story.attribution: Ryan Trattner, maker, on Product Hunt

fit: run onboarding or training and your internal courses keep going out of date
have training material spread across docs, recordings and tools
need practice exercises, not just quizzes
not_fit: are a solo learner: the Team plan starts at 10 seats
need SSO, audit logs or LTI integration without an enterprise contract
want fully automatic publishing without review: the team designs it for human approval

pricing.intro: Honen's pricing page lists two plans, in US dollars.

plans.name: Team
plans.detail: Unlimited AI course creation from your files, all nine learning formats, AI video lessons, voice AI tutor, certificates, shared workspace, assignments and analytics, SCORM export and shareable course sites, knowledge base, Slack and Teams notifications

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Bulk pricing over 100 seats; SSO/SAML and SCIM, roles and audit logs, LMS/LTI 1.3 and custom domains, knowledge-base chatbot in Slack, Teams and SMS, API, MCP server and custom connectors, dedicated success manager

notes: In the launch thread a maker said small-business pricing could be just under $10 per seat per month; the pricing page now shows $20 per seat for Team.

alternatives.intro: Creatium, EverLearns Studio and Mini Course Generator are on Product Hunt's alternatives list. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Creatium
items.difference: Focuses on authoring interactive lessons; Honen adds a knowledge base that keeps courses current and team analytics.

items.name: EverLearns Studio
items.what: Turns material into a course in minutes
items.difference: Fast course generation; Honen is built around company training, roleplays and assignments.

items.name: Mini Course Generator
items.difference: Short courses, often for marketing; Honen targets ongoing workforce training.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists GoIT LMS and Learn.xyz.

liked: Courses that update when source docs change
Version history with rollback per cohort
Purpose-built for team onboarding rather than individual study
asked: How it measures retention beyond completion (project-based learning and mastery tracking)
How updates reach learners mid-course (revisions with deploy and rollback)
Human oversight for compliance content (nothing goes live without approval unless you choose)
criticised: A commenter questioned whether course quality holds for judgment-heavy topics, not just factual recall

quotes.text: Honen feels purpose-built for onboarding a whole team, not just one person digesting docs.
quotes.author: Ulykbek Asylbek

quotes.text: Internal courses always go stale because nobody maintains them.
quotes.author: Oluwatoyin Riliwan Sunday

quotes.text: Seconds to generate something is easy. seconds to generate something an employee would actually learn from is much harder.
quotes.author: Ansari Adin

pros: Courses built from your own docs, recordings and knowledge base
Updates with version history and human approval
SOC 2 Type II and no AI training on your content, per its site
cons: SSO, audit logs and custom domains need Enterprise
Quality on judgment-heavy topics is unproven, a commenter noted

x.none: We found no posts about Honen on X to link yet.

faq.a: An AI platform that turns a company's documents, recordings and knowledge into interactive training courses with simulations, quizzes and an AI tutor, and keeps them updated.
The Team plan is $20 per seat per month with a minimum of 10 seats ($200 a month). Enterprise is custom, with bulk pricing over 100 seats.

faq.q: What happens when our docs change?
faq.a: Courses are tied to your knowledge base and can be updated as it changes. The team said each course is a revision you can deploy or roll back, and a person approves updates before learners see them.

faq.q: Can I use it with our existing LMS?
faq.a: Yes. Team includes SCORM export, and Enterprise adds LTI 1.3 integration.
StudyFetch, the study app company, which says it has taught more than 8 million students.
